title: Catamaran charter with friends
text: We chartered a catamaran for a group of friends in June. The food and service were beyond what we anticipated. It was a great relaxing day on the water. Note that for a day trip you mostly stick around Barcelona harbor, but it was nice just being together in the fresh air, drinking cava, and enjoying the sun and music. Steve and Esther were very professional, helpful, and friendly. We would gladly book with Sondevela again!
author: 316kiranm

title: Great crew and a wonderful experience
text: Our group of 7 chartered a day trip + catered lunch with Sondevela.  Everything exceeded our expectations - including the quality of the food, the roominess of the catamaran, and the hospitality of the crew.  The food service included even more than we anticipated.  We would highly recommend Sondevela if you want to spend a day on the water while in Barcelona.  Everything was so comfortable that we are considering chartering a multi-day trip with Sondevela the next time we are in Spain. The office staff at Sondevela are also very communicative and helpful.
author: BoardingPass309682

title: Perfect boat experience!
text: This trip was the highlight of our time in Barcelona. Esther could not do enough for us and made us feel so at home. Thank you for making my birthday a really special one!
author: Zoe_H

title: Amazing experience!
text: Amazing boat trip for our team company trip! The staff couldn't have been more attentive and there was plenty of great quality food and drinks for 9 people! Couldn't recommend more!
author: Isobel_P

title: Best bachelorette ever!
text: My girlfriends booked a catamaran with Sondevela for my surprise bachelorette party. We had an amazing time! The catamaran is very luxury and the crew was fantastic! A very happy bride-to-be!
author: travelpassion4life

title: “Booze cruise” with our 20 something son and college friends
text: We took a group of ten (parents and college students) on the catamaran for a five hour cruise. The staff was fantastic!! Captain Borja and Esther (who ran the show!) we’re top notch!! Great service. Accommodating and fun! Highly recommend them and this boat for a cruise along the Barcelona coast. Boat is perfect size for a group of 10-12, plenty of seating space and great for in water activities. Highly recommend it!!!
author: bretb678

title: Amazing Experience
text: One of the best things I have done in Barcelona! The boat was so beautiful! The crew was of 2 people and they were very sweet and made our experience even better! The food and drinks supplied were more than enough for 12 people. We had our own music too with bluetooth speakers on the boat. Initially I booked for 2hours but was so nice that we extended it with 1 and the service was great about this too. Overall 10/10 - highly recommended!
author: Christina_D

title: Best Boat Trip Ever!
text: Esther was incredible!! The food she prepared was amazing, the boat was so nice and no limit on the alcohol drank. Very relaxed and enjoyable environment. Esther was so fun and helpful. Could not recommend this experience more, would do it 100 times over!
author: Emily_K

title: Large Group Cruise
text:
Wonderful experience.  The boat was extremely lovely and accommodated our group of 11 easily.  Esther served food cava throughout our cruise.  Unfortunately the sea was rough and we were unable to leave the harbor, but the service and condition of the boat still made it a lovely outing.  

Communication was excellent!!  And if you are English speaking, they make everything very easy for you.
author: kyledean

title: Amazing experience!
text: Our family of 4 had an amazing time on this beautiful catamaran. Esthel served some delicious tapas, wine, and champagne.  She and the captain were very welcoming and easy going. Highly recommend spending a few hours on this trip. We did 3; should have done 4.
author: MF595
